extraction.text:
SURAJIT SINGHA

A highly skilled Software Engineer Specialist with 9+ years of experience in Telecom and IoT Streaming Analytics, specializing in building scalable distributed systems and resilient microservices architectures. Proven ability to leverage AI-powered tools like GitHub Copilot and OpenAI APIs within Spring Boot to accelerate development and deliver intelligent applications. Proficient in CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, and event-driven architectures.

 +919916306489

 surajitsukumar@gmail.com

 linkedin.com/in/surajit-singha-859a

7016a/

Bangalore, 560068

 Skills

 Education

Cambridge Institute of Technology, Visvesvaraya Technological University

Bachelor of Engineering - Computer Science and Engineering

 Experience

Cumulocity Software AG

Software Engineer Specialist

Bengaluru

 Contributed to the development of Streaming Analytics for Cumulocity, enhancing system stability, fault tolerance, and uptime in production environments by implementing resilience for the Analytics Builder feature.

 Developed and deployed multiple microservice variants tailored to specific feature requirements and deployment needs, optimizing resource utilization and scalability.

 Contributed to CI/CD pipeline development, automating software delivery and ensuring smooth, reliable deployments.

 Implemented a distributed listener mechanism for model resiliency, capturing, aggregating, and storing model state across threads to ensure consistent recovery and minimize data loss.

Software AG

Software Engineering Specialist

Bangalore

 Built the backend for a no-code Streaming Analytics platform, enabling non-technical users to define real-time analytics on telemetry data. Implemented multi-tenancy support and system resilience to ensure scalability and high availability. Mentored and led a team of 3 junior developers, providing technical guidance and support.

 Led the implementation of resilience for the Analytics Builder feature, ensuring high availability, fault tolerance, and seamless recovery in a distributed microservices environment.

 Managing Apama integration microservice to ensure seamless data flow between upstream and downstreamapplications.

 Developed key features within the APAMA event processing platform, contributing to the 'Smart Rule' and 'Subscription Manager' projects, enhancing real-time decision- making capabilities.



Netcracker Technology India Pvt Ltd

Sr. Software Engineer

Bangalore

 Served as a Senior Developer, contributing to all phases of the software development lifecycle—from design and analysis to development and post-production support.

 Mentored and led a team of 5 junior developers, providing technical guidance and fostering skill development, improving team performance and knowledge sharing.

 Developed a robust data migration service to transition data from a legacy system to a modern platform, enabling efficient bulk sales order processing through a multi- threaded application.

 Built an adapter service to enable seamless integration between Netcracker and third-party systems, including billing platforms, facilitating smooth communication across diverse systems.

 Designed and implemented offerings, rules, and order fulfillment processes within the OPF and Order Management system, streamlining service delivery.

 Designed and implemented APIs for managing offers, coupons, commitments, and business rules within the Enterprise Offer Manager (EOM) system, leveraging Java multi-threading to ensure high-performance rule creation.

 Projects

 Software AG/Cumulocity: Apama (Analytics Builder): Developed Multi-Tenancy support, optimized memory usage by removing JVM, and improved resilience for this streaming analytics platform.

 Netcracker Technology: TOMS (Greenfield): Contributed to OPF, Order Management, third-party integrations, and billing system integration to enable end-to-end service fulfillment.

 Enterprise Offer Manager (EOM): Designed and developed Offers, Commitments, and Coupons modules in TOMs from scratch, contributing to both High-Level Design (HLD) and Low-Level Design (LLD).

 AI Integration with Spring Boot: Implemented integration of OpenAI APIs into Spring Boot microservices to deliver intelligent features, enhancing application capabilities.

 Leveraged GitHub Copilot to boost productivity, automate boilerplate code generation, and ensure faster prototyping, accelerating the development lifecycle.

 Accomplishments

 Modernized tech stack (Spring Boot, Java, WebClient) to improve performance and maintainability, and delivered key features like Multiple Billing, Multiport, Work Order, and Scheduled Appointment, resulting in enhanced system efficiency.

 Developed APIs for Offers, Commitments, and Coupons in TOMs, and upgraded APAMA platform, earning client appreciation and a performance excellence award, demonstrating impact and client satisfaction.

 Reduced infrastructure costs by removing the JVM, significantly decreasing memory usage in containers for individual instances.

 Engineered a multi-threaded API to efficiently process a partitioned model, maximizing throughput and minimizing latency.

 Developed APIs for Offers, Commitments, and Coupons in TOMs, and upgraded APAMA platform, earning client appreciation and a performance excellence award, demonstrating impact and client satisfaction.

 Recognized with 7 Thumb-Up performance awards at Netcracker and Best Performer award at Software AG for contributions to critical APAMA solutions, highlighting exceptional performance and contributions

 Awards

 Recognized with 7 Thumb-Up performance awards at Netcracker and Best Performer award at Software AG forcontributions to critical APAMA solutions, highlighting exceptional performance and contributions
